specs.name: 清正·后收束发
specs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create a REVISED male whole-portrait candidate, vertical1024x1536.
Image1 is the HAIRSTYLE/BODY/COMPOSITION edit target from a rejected draft. Keep its distinct hairstyle, fine charcoal-black strands, clothes, green/gold robe, background, body, pose, neck/collar and general head placement. Its FACE WAS REJECTED as unattractive. Redesign the face appreciably; do not keep that heavy flat feature combination.
Image2 is the approved PROJECT MASTER and binding PAINTING/PALETTE/BEAUTY-BALANCE reference: delicate matte gongbi/ink-and-wash, smooth light warm peach skin, soft low-contrast shading, fine natural brows, clear modest almond eyes and coordinated nose/lips. Match this image's warm pale skin directly; do not tan, yellow, darken or bleach it.
Image3 is an existing Tale of Immortal/鬼谷八荒 game screenshot, reference for harmonious MALE FACIAL PROPORTIONS/CHARISMA ONLY. Ignore its pose, outfit, accessories, UI, hard comic outlines and color/rendering style; everything must remain the project's soft fine-painted hand from image2. Do not recreate that game character.
CRITICAL USER FEEDBACK: the previous faces were too blunt/heavy/dull. The new man must be CLEARLY GOOD-LOOKING in a restrained, upright masculine way: 清朗、端正、耐看、有英气. Allow attractive, coordinated features. Keep one or two personal traits per man, with the remaining features harmonious. No over-thick coarse brows combined with sleepy slits, bulbous wide nose and flat heavy lips. No dull downward-hanging expression. Equally avoid feminine doll face, glamorous makeup, tiny V chin or exaggerated perfect fashion-model sculpting.
FACIAL BASELINE: natural medium/slender clean brows with fine tapered ends; horizontally well-shaped almond eyes with a MODERATE natural opening and visible calm focused pupils, both equal size and level, no over-compressed sleepy lids and no oversized anime eyes. A clear straight proportionate nose bridge, compact natural rounded tip and complete neat nasal wings. Medium-width well-shaped matte lips, moderate thickness with natural upper-lip curve, relaxed corners, no dead-flat mouth line or exaggerated pout. Cheeks flow smoothly into a gently tapering masculine jaw and a soft pointed/rounded chin, not a blocky wide jaw or sharp needle chin.
Young adult East Asian man, clean-shaven, healthy smooth skin, no scars, beard, middle-aged forehead/canthus wrinkles or old/manly rough texture. Preserve source common-frame placement approximately eyes nearx460/568,y366, tipx516,y442, lipsx517,y479, chinx518,y541; keep skull size and neck/collar alignment compatible. Do not enlarge eyes or head.
One portrait, same full-canvas framing and paper-beige backdrop, no text, labels, collage or added props. Keep the hairstyle DIFFERENCES from image1, not six copies of the same face/hair.
DESIGN: A clear upright young man with neat slightly strong straight eyebrows, clear medium-small long almond eyes and an alert calm expression. A moderately firm but elegant masculine nose bridge with normal compact nasal tip/wings. Natural medium-thin upper lip, slightly fuller lower lip and relaxed mouth, no pressed-down corners. A moderately defined jaw that narrows naturally into a gentle rounded chin. His structure is a little firmer than the project master, while retaining its pleasing balance. Keep image1's all-hair-gathered LOW COILED KNOT and exposed ears/forehead; tidy a few excessive flyaways but retain natural hairline. No loose chest-length curtains.
